name: Osteoclast development via M-CSF signaling
rationale: Members cover osteoclast/macrophage proliferation, fusion, differentiation and bone resorption; the M-CSF (CSF1) signaling members separate it from osteoclast-only confusables, and the osteoclast/bone members from M-CSF/monocyte-differentiation confusables.

name: Platelet activation via soluble-agonist G protein-coupled receptors
rationale: All members concern platelet activation, aggregation and coagulation; the ADP P2Y1/P2Y12, thrombin PAR, thromboxane and prostacyclin receptor members distinguish it from confusables built on collagen/GP1b adhesion or integrin-Rap1 signaling.

name: Planar cell polarity driving convergent extension
rationale: Members share PCP establishment and the convergent-extension tissue movements it drives (gastrulation, axis elongation, neural plate); convergent extension and neural plate morphogenesis are what PCP-only confusables lack, while axial-mesoderm confusables lack the PCP core.

name: Gi/z-coupled adenylate cyclase inhibition
rationale: Members describe GPCR control of cAMP via inhibitory adenylate cyclase pathways (alpha-2 adrenergic, G alpha z); the general AC-inhibition terms separate it from adrenergic-secretion confusables, and the inhibitory direction from the cAMP/PKA-activation confusable.

name: NK cell cytotoxicity regulation via MHC class Ib recognition
rationale: Members regulate NK (and T cell) activation, cytokine production, degranulation and cytotoxicity through NK receptor-ligand interactions; MHC class Ib presentation and negative NK regulation distinguish it from confusables, which add T-cell proliferation, granzyme killing or KIR modules.

name: Embryonic craniofacial morphogenesis with limb patterning
rationale: Members are embryonic mesenchyme-driven shaping of face, palate, nose and skull together with fore/hindlimb and digit morphogenesis; the limb and digit members distinguish it from confusables that pair craniofacial terms with pharyngeal organs or ossification.

name: Fibroblast cell-matrix adhesion with fibronectin assembly
rationale: Members share focal adhesion assembly, integrin production, fibronectin matrix formation and fibroblast migration; fibronectin/TGFB-collagen matrix building distinguishes it from integrin/syndecan-interaction confusables and from the EMT confusable.

name: Skeletal myogenesis restraint during atrophy and inactivity
rationale: Members negatively regulate myoblast/myotube differentiation and muscle development and maintain satellite cells, alongside atrophy and inactivity responses; the negative-regulation and atrophy members distinguish it from pro-myogenic, contractile and hypertrophy confusables.

name: Recombination-based telomere maintenance via break-induced replication
rationale: Members concern telomere replication, capping and recombination (t-circles, D-loops) with DNA unwinding and replication-stress checkpoints; break-induced replication, DNA unwinding and mitotic recombination resolution distinguish it from telomere confusables focused on C-strand synthesis, R-loops or general DNA repair.

name: PKA activation by adenylate cyclase-generated cAMP
rationale: All members describe GPCR-driven cAMP synthesis (including forskolin) leading to PKA activation; cAMP biosynthesis and the GPCR-cAMP coupling distinguish it from CREB-focused confusables and from the adenylate-cyclase-inhibition confusable.

name: COPI-coated vesicle targeting between Golgi and ER
rationale: Members concern vesicle budding and targeting between ER exit sites and Golgi; COPI budding and Golgi-to-ER retrograde traffic distinguish it from COPII, tethering and ER-insertion confusables.

name: Kidney development with nephron tubule segmentation
rationale: All members are kidney and urogenital duct development (nephric duct, ureteric bud, metanephric mesenchyme); the nephron tubule segment members (loop of Henle, distal tubule, S/comma-shaped bodies, proximal-distal patterning) distinguish it from ureteric-bud-induction confusables.

name: Endosomal receptor recycling with vesicular cholesterol transport
rationale: Members regulate endocytosis, endosome organization and recycling of receptors and proteins to the plasma membrane; vesicular cholesterol transport and the Golgi-traffic module distinguish it from close recycling confusables, and the recycling core from endosome-to-Golgi and tubulation confusables.

name: Myeloid progenitor transcription restraining terminal differentiation
rationale: Members describe transcriptional programs (RUNX1, VENTX, granulopoiesis) and proliferation of immature myeloid progenitors with negative regulation of granulocyte, monocyte and macrophage differentiation; the progenitor-maintenance and negative-regulation members distinguish it from confusables driving differentiation or monocyte trafficking.

name: RAF-MEK-ERK signaling with phosphatase feedback inactivation
rationale: Members cover RAF, MAP2K and MAPK activation including oncogenic RAF/RAS/MAP2K mutants; ERK inactivation, dephosphorylation and negative feedback distinguish it from activation-only confusables, and the RAF-level focus from RAS-GAP confusables.

name: Redox-active vitamin metabolism with vitamin K-dependent carboxylation
rationale: Members concern metabolism of and responses to vitamins K, C and E; vitamin K gamma-carboxylation distinguishes it from the oxygen-transport confusable, and ascorbate members from vitamin E/ubiquinol and vitamin D confusables.

name: Dendritic cell CCL5 production downstream of cGAS-STING
rationale: Members concern dendritic cell cytokine and CCL5 chemokine production with cGAS-STING activation and cGAMP import; cGAS-STING distinguishes it from Th1/IL-12 and macrophage-chemokine confusables, and DC/CCL5 production from the interferon-centred cGAS confusable.

name: Non-coding RNA methylation with snRNP biogenesis
rationale: Members concern methylation and modification of rRNA, tRNA, snRNA and caps with snoRNP/scaRNA handling; snRNP assembly, snRNA transport and cap hypermethylation distinguish it from pseudouridylation and diphthamide confusables.

name: mRNA stability and translational control via stress granules
rationale: Members regulate mRNA stabilization/destabilization by RNA-binding proteins and translation under stress (PKR, arsenite); stress granule assembly/disassembly and translational silencing distinguish it from confusables centred on deadenylation and decay factors.

qualifier: in embryonic cartilage and joint morphogenesis
name: Chondrocyte development in embryonic cartilage and joint morphogenesis
rationale: Members regulate chondrocyte proliferation, differentiation and hypertrophy with cartilage condensation; joint and cartilage morphogenesis distinguish it from confusables adding ossification, tendon or articular cartilage homeostasis.

name: Pancreatic beta-cell insulin secretion via KATP channels
rationale: Members concern beta-cell insulin processing and secretion regulated by glucose, fatty acids, incretins and neurotransmitters; ATP-sensitive potassium channels (ABCC8/ABCC9) distinguish it from confusables centred on insulin action and GLUT4 translocation.

name: Ubiquitin-proteasome degradation with deubiquitinase chain editing
rationale: Members cover ubiquitin chain synthesis of many linkages, deubiquitinase families, proteasome assembly and regulated proteasomal catabolism; DUB/chain-editing and proteasome members distinguish it from ERAD/autophagy quality-control and neddylation confusables.

name: Rab-regulated Golgi vesicle traffic and organization
rationale: Members concern Golgi structure and vesicle budding, tethering and retrograde traffic; Rab GEF/GAP and geranylgeranylation members distinguish it from TGN-lysosome confusables, and COPI intra-Golgi traffic from the Ral/GTPase confusable.

name: Proline-centred amino acid metabolism
rationale: Members are amino acid metabolic, biosynthetic and catabolic terms whose only specific content is proline synthesis and catabolism (glutamine family); proline distinguishes it from glycine, serine and organic-acid confusables.

name: Vitamin A metabolism with retinoid transport disorders
rationale: Members cover retinol, retinal and retinoic acid metabolism and transport; STRA6 and retinoid-metabolism disease members distinguish it from retinoic-acid-response and vitamin D confusables, and RA synthesis from the visual-cycle confusable.

name: Telomere end protection suppressing recombination
rationale: Members concern telomere capping, packaging and protection from NHEJ and recombination; inhibition of recombination and telomerase restraint distinguish it from replication-based telomere confusables, and NHEJ protection from the telomerase/Cajal-body confusable.

name: Nucleotide cofactor and high-energy phosphate interconversion
rationale: Members concern interconversion and mitochondrial transport of ADP/ATP/GTP, phosphocreatine and NAD(P); NAD/nicotinate members distinguish it from PRPP and mitochondrial-apoptosis confusables, and creatine/ATP transport from nucleotide-biosynthesis confusables.

name: Telomere maintenance with telomerase RNA Cajal-body trafficking
rationale: Members cover telomerase extension, C-strand synthesis, ALT recombination, capping and telomeric heterochromatin; Cajal-body localization of telomerase RNA distinguishes it from DNA-repair-heavy confusables, and telomere maintenance from senescence and chromatin confusables.

name: TLR-driven inflammatory cytokine production with inflammasome IL-1 processing
rationale: Members regulate TLR2/4 and LPS signaling and IL-1, IL-6 and TNF production in inflammation; NLRP1/NLRP3 inflammasome and IL-1 processing distinguish it from TLR-signaling confusables, and LPS/TLR2/4 sensing from the pyroptosis confusable.

name: Canonical Wnt signaling via AXIN destruction-complex stability
rationale: Members concern beta-catenin/TCF signaling controlled by the APC/AXIN destruction complex; AXIN degradation and stabilization distinguish it from confusables centred on DVL/FZD activation or target-gene repression.
